PROMO_TEXT_BATTERINGRAM:
Need a way to close out a game? Finding Solomon Ion Cannon's to just fall short of what you need? Having trouble breaching a base protected by rocks?

This anti-structure specialist will finish the game and the opponent for you in quick work as it climbs over and onto rocks that stand in your way.
PROMO_TEXT_CATALYSTGUNSHIP:
Need a cheaper solution than Jade's Catalyst Missile? Finding difficulty dealing with multi-pronged attacks from infantry and vehicles? Need something to pair alongside your Chemical units?

The Catalyst Gunship, outfitted with two weapons, will activate clouds of Tiberium Gas and trigger a deadly, contained explosion on your enemies all on its own.
PROMO_TEXT_CENTURION:
Tired of getting incinerated by the Ion Cannon?
Want a unit that can shrug off even the biggest attacks?

This shielded mech can hold a point against even the most determined enemy attack. Use it to go toe to toe with GDI’s heaviest hitters.
PROMO_TEXT_FANATIC:
Tired of just barely losing fights? Feeling frustrated by powerful enemy units? Need a unit that can buff up all its surrounding allies?

The Fanatic leads the charge on the battlefield providing instantaneous support to its allies upon death. Use their glorious sacrifice to pave the way to victory!
PROMO_TEXT_GRENADIER:
Getting rocked by the Rockworm? 
Need a heavier anti-vehicle infantry than the Missile Squad? 
Want to slow down that Flame Tank rushing towards your base?

These tough anti-vehicle squads can disable even the biggest enemy vehicles.
PROMO_TEXT_JACKSON:
Lagging behind the faster Scorpion Tanks? Having trouble contesting the points? Finding yourself falling behind?

Col. Jackson provides a Movement Speed and Attack Speed boost to a target unit on the battlefield. Deploy his powers in battle to quickly reach a point or win a battle favorably.
PROMO_TEXT_JADE:
Having trouble breaking through clusters of enemies? Looking for a way to capitalize on Tiberium minerals and clouds?

Jade's Catalyst Missile deals damage to any unit in the hex you target. It can also chain react and create a larger explosion if it hits a cloud of Tiberium Gas or a patch of Tiberium mineral.
PROMO_TEXT_KANE:
Having trouble defending an area of the map? Looking for a way to assert dominance over the battlefield?

Kane, the leader of the Brotherhood of Nod, can deploy his Obelisk of Light to cover a large area of the map with a destructive structure.
PROMO_TEXT_LIANG:
Units dying too quickly on the field of battle? Need a way to bring your Tanks and Rhinos up to full, fighting power? Struggling to recover with weakened units?

Dr. Liang can deploy a healing drone to heal your units back up to full HP. Use it to force a fight in your favor and stabilize your position on the battlefield.
PROMO_TEXT_MCNEIL: During the Second Tiberium War, Commander McNeil led the assault on a recently captured GDI Base, Hammerfest, to prevent capture of the Sonic Crystals. By diffusing some of the focused sonic waves, a wide-reaching, sonic field was created that would impede the movement and actions of anything within its radius, both mechanical and organic. This technology, coined as the Resonance Field, is now accessible thanks to McNeil.
PROMO_TEXT_MSV:
Finding yourself just falling short of contesting the Missile before it fires? Feeling like your Predator Tanks are too slow to make it to battle?

The M.S.V. provides a slight Speed boost and Attack Damage increase to all adjacent vehicles. Use it to reinforce your War Factory as you dominate the playing field.
PROMO_TEXT_MUTANT_MARAUDER:
Trouble tackling the Titan?
Need inexpensive infantry unit that can handle the biggest enemy vehicles out there?
 
This squad of three anti-vehicle infantry is a cost-efficient way to crush heavy late game vehicles like the Rockworm or Sandstorm.
PROMO_TEXT_ORCABOMBER:
Having trouble clearing a point?
Feeling frustrated by an M.L.R.S. sitting behind cover?

This anti-ground aircraft unit will blow away everything it flies over in a matter of seconds.
PROMO_TEXT_OXANNA:
Not enough explosive strength? Lacking the ability to take down opponents quickly? Looking to empower your units at the risk of death?

Oxanna's Fanaticism can grant a unit bonus Attack Speed and Movement Speed at the cost of taking additional damage. If used properly, it can easily shift a fight in your favor and melt down the strongest of enemies.
PROMO_TEXT_RAZORBACK:
Enemy infantry slipping out of our grasp? Mutant Marauders breaking through your defensive lines? Need a heavier anti-infantry aircraft than a Talon or Drone Swarm?

The Razorback is the GDI's answer to any and all infantry. Use them to chase down your opponent's infantry across the battlefield.
PROMO_TEXT_SCAVENGER:
Feeling like you're running out of Tiberium? Can't find a way to generate Tiberium faster?

Use the Scavenger to reap the rewards of the battlefield. Place them near dying units to capitalize on their deaths.
PROMO_TEXT_SETH:
Need a way to penetrate the backline? Want a quick answer to infantry? Looking for a way to sneak past your opponent's defensive line to take down their base?

Seth can deploy a drill pod that unleashes Flame Troopers onto the field of battle. Take advantage of its ability to spawn behind enemy lines to wreak havoc.
PROMO_TEXT_SHATTERER:
Getting burned out by the Flame Troopers? Tired of getting picked off by Snipers? Need a vehicle counter to infantry? 

Use the Shatterer to stun the enemy infantry and melt them down before they can escape!
PROMO_TEXT_SLINGSHOT:
Getting burned by Infernos? 
Want to hammer on Hammerheads? 

This dedicated anti-aircraft vehicle will make your enemy’s air forces nothing but flying scrap. Add them to any army having trouble dealing with enemy aircraft.
PROMO_TEXT_SOLOMON:
Feeling weak against enemy fortifications? Having trouble breaking past a defensive set-up? Helpless against a swarm of powerful units controlling a Missile Platform?

General Solomon is capable of blasting an area of map dealing massive damage to any unit, friend or foe, in its path. Use it to clear away Missile Platforms and retake control of the battle.
PROMO_TEXT_STRONGARM:
Need a solution to just about anything? Having trouble reinforcing your units quickly?

Lt. Strongarm can instanteously place a Turret that is strong against all types onto the Battlefield. Use her to quickly change the tide of the fight in your favor.
PROMO_TEXT_WRAITH:
Are Banshee's no longer cutting it for you? Are Pitbulls and Stealth Tanks ripping through your air forces? Need a way to approach a target without taking enemy fire?

The Shade will sneak its way into the depths of enemy lines and disrupt their weaponry before taking out its target in quick fashion.

TIP_APC_1_DESCRIPTION: The GDI APC is extremely durable and leaves behind a Missile Squad when destroyed, making the APC ideal for holding Missile Platforms.
TIP_ATTACKBIKE_1_DESCRIPTION: Attack Bikes are fast and ferocious vehicles that eliminate enemy vehicles and aircraft with volleys of missiles.
TIP_AVATAR_1_DESCRIPTION: The Avatar Warmech explodes upon death, dealing damage to any adjacent ground units.
TIP_BANSHEE_1_DESCRIPTION: Banshee plasma attacks are effective against both ground and air vehicles.
TIP_BASILISK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Basilisk's continuous laser beam is great for taking out large enemy units from a distance.
TIP_BATTERINGRAM_1_DESCRIPTION: Use the Battering Ram to make quick work of your enemy’s base.
TIP_BUGGY_1_DESCRIPTION: Fast and sleek, Buggies are perfect for harassing and eliminating enemy infantry.
TIP_CATALYSTGUNSHIP_1_DESCRIPTION: Pair the Catalyst Gunship with other Chemical units to trigger its Catalyst Rounds more frequently.
TIP_CENTURION_1_DESCRIPTION: The Centurion's shield allows them to take fights favorably. Maneuver the Centurion away from enemies while the shield is recharging.
TIP_CHALLENGE_BATTLES_DISABLED: Medals are not a criteria for Challenge Battles in Tiberium League.
TIP_CHEMICALWARRIOR_1_DESCRIPTION: The Chemical Warrior's Tiberium Gas attack persists on the battlefield for a time.
TIP_CHEMICALWARRIOR_2_DESCRIPTION: Jade's Catalyst Missile will deal damage to a larger area if it targets Tiberium Gas or Fields.
TIP_CHEMQUAD_1_DESCRIPTION: The Chem Buggy's ability to fire while moving can be used to hose down multiple enemy units quickly.
TIP_COMBAT_10_DESCRIPTION: Keep enemy units away from your base so they can’t scout your buildings.
TIP_COMBAT_11_DESCRIPTION: Infantry take damage while in Tiberium fields.
TIP_COMBAT_12_DESCRIPTION: No plan survives contact with the enemy. Change your tactics as battle progresses.
TIP_COMBAT_13_DESCRIPTION: Moving Harvesters on to Missile Platforms is a great way to sneakily gain missile control.
TIP_COMBAT_14_DESCRIPTION: Save Tiberium for more expensive units. The more a unit costs, the stronger it is!
TIP_COMBAT_15_DESCRIPTION: Use units that are strong against structures to attack the enemy base.
TIP_COMBAT_16_DESCRIPTION: Protect your base. The enemy can destroy it by direct assault.
TIP_COMBAT_17_DESCRIPTION: Defenders shoot first. Try to get into position before your enemy does.
TIP_COMBAT_18_DESCRIPTION: Don’t let your units stand in fire.
TIP_COMBAT_19_DESCRIPTION: Willingness to RETREAT from a bad unit matchup separates good players from great.
TIP_COMBAT_1_DESCRIPTION: Build Harvesters to earn more Tiberium during the battle.
TIP_COMBAT_20_DESCRIPTION: Study the terrain and find ways to use it to your advantage.
TIP_COMBAT_21_DESCRIPTION: Unit counters are key to winning battles. Learn them and gain the advantage!
TIP_COMBAT_22_DESCRIPTION: There are four types of units: infantry, vehicles, aircraft and structures.
TIP_COMBAT_23_DESCRIPTION: Control of the missile can swing rapidly. Be aware of when the missile is about to fire.
TIP_COMBAT_24_DESCRIPTION: Balance your army composition to take on any potential threats.
TIP_COMBAT_25_DESCRIPTION: Balance your army’s unit costs to be competitive early and late in a battle
TIP_COMBAT_26_DESCRIPTION: Playing with sound on can give you a tactical advantage over your rival.
TIP_COMBAT_2_DESCRIPTION: Destroy enemy Harvesters to slow down your opponent's economy.
TIP_COMBAT_3_DESCRIPTION: The more units you have on the field, the longer it takes to build new ones.
TIP_COMBAT_4_DESCRIPTION: Earn bonus Tiberium by destroying enemy Harvesters.
TIP_COMBAT_5_DESCRIPTION: Harvesters produce Tiberium faster as the battle progresses.
TIP_COMBAT_6_DESCRIPTION: Protect your Harvesters. Losing a Harvester hurts your economy and helps the enemy’s.
TIP_COMBAT_7_DESCRIPTION: You can rebuild your Harvesters for free when they are destroyed.
TIP_COMBAT_8_DESCRIPTION: Build two Harvesters only if you are playing with an expensive army.
TIP_COMBAT_9_DESCRIPTION: Missiles will fire after 40 seconds of charging. Be ready and in control!
TIP_CONFESSOR_1_DESCRIPTION: Nod Confessors buff friendly infantry units, increasing their combat effectiveness.
TIP_CONTROLPOINTS_1_DESCRIPTION: If all the Missile Platforms are empty or contested the missile's launch sequence will pause.
TIP_CYBER_WHEELS_1_DESCRIPTION: The Cyber Wheels are fragile alone, but strong in a pack.
TIP_CYBORG_1_DESCRIPTION: Cyborg EMP blasts are good at slowing down troublesome enemy vehicles.
TIP_DISRUPTOR_1_DESCRIPTION: Use the Disruptor to destroy enemy structures and infantry from long range.
TIP_DRONESWARM_1_DESCRIPTION: Use Drone Swarms to quickly occupy Missile Platforms and steal missile control just before launch.
TIP_FAIRPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION: When playing across leagues the lower level cap is used.
TIP_FAIRPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION: Win streaks start on your third win and boost the medals you'll earn per match.
TIP_FAIRPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION: You lose no medals during a challenge match and a win earns you bonus experience.
TIP_FANATIC_1_DESCRIPTION: Whenever a Fanatic squad member dies, it will apply a buff to all allied units around it. Position them in between your units to maximize their effect.
TIP_FIREBOMBER_1_DESCRIPTION: Plan your Inferno attack runs to damage multiple targets in a line.
TIP_FLAMETANK_1_DESCRIPTION: Flame Tanks burn through squads of enemy infantry with a massive cone of fire.
TIP_FLAMETROOPERS_1_DESCRIPTION: Flame Troopers bathe enemies in fire — killing enemy infantry and destroying enemy structures.
TIP_GIGACANNON_1_DESCRIPTION: The Giga-Cannon's continuous laser beam can split to hit multiple enemy targets. Great for clearing Missile Platforms.
TIP_GRENADIER_1_DESCRIPTION: Use the Grenadier's EMP effect to slow enemy Vehicles down significantly and destroy them while they are incapacitated.
TIP_HAMMERHEAD_1_DESCRIPTION: The Hammerhead is GDI's premier air-superiority aircraft. Use it to shut down enemy air forces.
TIP_HARVESTERS_1_DESCRIPTION: Harvesters automatically travel to Tiberium fields, but they can also be ordered to specific locations.
TIP_JACKSON_1_DESCRIPTION: Jackson's Heroic Charge is good for rushing a unit to combat or giving it a boost to win an engagement.
TIP_JADE_1_DESCRIPTION: Timing is vital when launching Jade's Catalyst Missile. Target Tiberium fields to increase its damage and area of effect!
TIP_JUGGERNAUT_1_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Juggernaut can bombard a large area at up to 3 range.
TIP_JUMPTROOPERS_1_DESCRIPTION: Jump Jet Troopers can launch over obstacles and enemy units. Use them to get behind enemy lines.
TIP_KANE_1_DESCRIPTION: Kane's Obelisk of Light is a shining symbol of the Brotherhood's righteousness.
TIP_KODIAK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Kodiak can devastate the enemy's front lines by attacking three targets at once.
TIP_LASER_DRONES_1_DESCRIPTION: The Laser Drone does extremely high damage to vehicles and harvesters.
TIP_LIANG_1_DESCRIPTION: Dr. Liang's Repair Drone can heal adjacent units. Direct it where it can do the most good without taking enemy fire.
TIP_MAMMOTHTANK_1_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Mammoth Tank is so large it can crush entire enemy infantry squads.
TIP_MARAUDER_1_DESCRIPTION: Utilize the tankiness of Marauders to take down enemy Vehicles. Their high HP will tip the scales in their favor.
TIP_MCNEIL_1_DESCRIPTION: Traps last indefinitely. Aim to have two on the battlefield at all times to control the map.
TIP_META_BATTLELOG_1_DESCRIPTION: Learn from your past! You can view replays of your recent battles in the Match History section of your Profile.
TIP_META_BATTLETHEATERS_1_DESCRIPTION: As you progress with both factions, you will battle on different maps.
TIP_META_BATTLETHEATERS_2_DESCRIPTION: Earn crates by gaining Medals with both GDI and Brotherhood of Nod.

TIP_META_BOOSTS_2_DESCRIPTION: Purchase Boosts in the Store to gain more Credits and XP per battle.

TIP_META_BOUNTIES_2_DESCRIPTION: Complete your bounties! You'll get new bounties daily.
TIP_META_BOUNTIES_3_DESCRIPTION: Uncompleted bounties carry over from day to day.
TIP_META_BOUNTIES_4_DESCRIPTION: Have a bounty you don't want to do? Spend extra fuel to get a new one.

TIP_META_CLONINGLAB_5_DESCRIPTION: Fill the Cloning Lab.  All Chambers make progress simultaneously with each battle.

TIP_META_CLONINGLAB_7_DESCRIPTION: You can clone any card, even Epics, in the Cloning Lab.

TIP_META_LINKACCOUNT_2_DESCRIPTION: Find friends by linking your Command & Conquer™: Rivals account to Facebook!
TIP_META_PLAYERLEVEL_1_DESCRIPTION: Reaching higher player levels can add new units and commanders to your crates!
TIP_META_PLAYERLEVEL_2_DESCRIPTION: Reaching higher player levels can increase the amount of Credits and cards earned from crates and bounties.
TIP_META_PLAYERLEVEL_3_DESCRIPTION: Player level is increased by gaining experience from battles, bounties, donations, divisional promotion and leveling up units.
TIP_META_PLAYERLEVEL_4_DESCRIPTION: When you reach maximum level you can still gain experience and earn rewards.
TIP_META_PLAYERLEVEL_5_DESCRIPTION: Bonus experience is earned from your first 10 battles of the day.  Be sure to play them to maximize your progress.
TIP_META_PROGRESSION_1_DESCRIPTION: Read about your units and commanders to better understand their strengths and weaknesses.
TIP_META_STORE_1_DESCRIPTION: Need cards? Check the Daily Offers in the Store to spend Credits on the cards you need.
TIP_META_TRAINING_1_DESCRIPTION: Training units increases their health and damage, giving you an edge in battle.
TIP_META_TRAINING_2_DESCRIPTION: Train and level your commanders to upgrade their command power, as well as the health of your base and Harvesters.
TIP_META_UNITLEVEL_1_DESCRIPTION: Leveling up units gives them a significant increase in health and damage.
TIP_META_UNITS_1_DESCRIPTION: Units and commanders can be upgraded to Level 15.
TIP_META_UNITS_2_DESCRIPTION: Units come in 3 tiers of rarity: Common, Rare and Epic.
TIP_MGSQUAD_1_DESCRIPTION: MG Squads are ideal for harvester protection and defending strategic locations.
TIP_MILITANTS_1_DESCRIPTION: The Militants low cost and long vision range makes them excellent scouts.
TIP_MLRS_1_DESCRIPTION: Set up the M.L.R.S. behind friendly units and bombard enemies from afar.
TIP_MOHAWK_GUNSHIP_1_DESCRIPTION: The Mohawk Gunship is durable and provides consistent anti-vehicle damage from the air.
TIP_MSV_1_DESCRIPTION: Place the M.S.V. in between your base and the line of combat to keep it safe but effective.
TIP_NODARTILLERY_1_DESCRIPTION: The Nod Artillery has the longest range of any offensive unit. It can even fire further than it can see!
TIP_NOD_1_DESCRIPTION: Brotherhood of Nod is a quasi-religious paramilitary group dedicated to their leader Kane and the spread of Tiberium.
TIP_ORCA_1_DESCRIPTION: Orcas are aerial assassins, hitting enemy ground vehicles with a quick, 4-rocket volley.
TIP_ORCA_BOMBER_1_DESCRIPTION: Use the Orca Bomber to quickly sweep the point away from your enemies.
TIP_OXANNA_1_DESCRIPTION: Using Oxanna's Fanaticism ability gives units extra firepower at crucial points during the battle.
TIP_PITBULL_1_DESCRIPTION: Use the Pitbull's speed and missiles to hunt down and destroy enemy aircraft and vehicles.
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_1_DESCRIPTION: Tap your name on the landing page to access the player profile
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_2_DESCRIPTION: Visit the player level reward tab on your profile to see where all the units unlock.
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_3_DESCRIPTION: Your profile is full of interesting stats about how you play.
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_4_DESCRIPTION: View your past battles from your log on your profile.
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_5_DESCRIPTION: Visit other player's profiles to add them as friends.
TIP_PLAYER_PROFILE_6_DESCRIPTION: Save favorite battle replays in your profile.
TIP_PREDATORTANK_1_DESCRIPTION: Predator tanks can fire while on the move! Use them to hunt down enemy vehicles and block paths while attacking.
TIP_RAZORBACK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Razorback is able to strafe while chasing down enemy Infantry. Angle your approach accordingly.
TIP_RHINO_1_DESCRIPTION: Rhinos are lightly armored trucks perfect for anti-infantry and scouting missions.
TIP_RIFLEMEN_1_DESCRIPTION: Riflemen are the backbone of the GDI army. They're strong against infantry and make good scouts.
TIP_RIVALS_CHAMPIONS_1_DESCRIPTION: Compete in Rivals Champions events to show off your skill and claim big prizes.
TIP_RIVALS_CHAMPIONS_2_DESCRIPTION: You can retry a Rivals Champions event to try to get a better score.
TIP_RIVALS_CHAMPIONS_3_DESCRIPTION: Rivals Champions events run for a limited time.
TIP_ROCKETTROOPERS_1_DESCRIPTION: Missile Squads, though vulnerable to enemy infantry, can decimate enemy aircraft and vehicles.
TIP_ROCKWORM_1_DESCRIPTION: Rockworms cannot be damaged while moving underground. Make sure to take them out when they resurface.
TIP_SANDSTORM_1_DESCRIPTION: The Sandstorm is most effective when attacking three targets at once.
TIP_SCARAB_1_DESCRIPTION: Scarabs are most effective when they are defending a position. Make sure to set them up before the enemy arrives.
TIP_SCAVENGER_1_DESCRIPTION: Position your Scavenger next to units in combat to gain Tiberium when they die.
TIP_SCORPIONTANK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Scorpion Tank is the Brotherhood's answer to the GDI Predator.
TIP_SEASONS_RESET_BEHAVIOR: All players get reset back to Bronze at the end of a ranked season. You then immediately earn bonus medals based on how many Divisions you reached in the previous season.
TIP_SEASONS_REWARDS_DESCRIPTION: When a new ranked season begins the rewards for reaching a ranked Division can be earned again.
TIP_SEASONS_START_TIME: Ranked seasons begin on the first Wednesday of a new month.
TIP_SETH_1_DESCRIPTION: Deploy Seth's Flame Troopers behind enemy lines to gain valuable intelligence and disrupt enemy reinforcements.
TIP_SHATTERER_1_DESCRIPTION: The Shatterer uses sonic-seismic tech to stun enemy Infantry temporarily. Focus fire the stunned units to take them down without retaliation.
TIP_SHOCKWAVESQUAD_1_DESCRIPTION: Shockwave Troopers shatter enemy infantry and structures with beams of sonic energy.
TIP_SKYFIREANDJADE_1_DESCRIPTION: Dr. Liang and Jade worked together in a research lab until an accident almost killed them and their ambitions drove them apart.
TIP_SLINGSHOT_1_DESCRIPTION: Position the Slingshot behind your forward troops to take advantage of its 2 range.
TIP_SNIPERTEAM_1_DESCRIPTION: Sniper Teams can attack from two tiles away. Use that advantage to surprise your enemies.
TIP_SOLOMON_1_DESCRIPTION: Solomon's Ion Cannon is great for clearing Missile Platforms, but it will damage friendly as well as enemy forces.
TIP_STEALTHTANK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Stealth Tank is perfect for infiltration missions and surprising enemies with a flurry of rockets.
TIP_STORMTROOPERS_1_DESCRIPTION: Equipped with heavy laser cannons, Nod Laser Squads can effectively destroy enemy aircraft and vehicles.
TIP_STRONGARM_1_DESCRIPTION: Lt. Strongarm's Turret is good for blocking enemy units and ambushing enemy infantry.
TIP_TALON_1_DESCRIPTION: The Talon is a great early choice for hunting enemy infantry and aircraft.
TIP_TICKTANK_1_DESCRIPTION: The Tick Tank burrows into the ground when stopped, greatly increasing its durability in combat.
TIP_TITAN_1_DESCRIPTION: Try and line up the Titan's shots to hit multiple enemies in a row to maximize its effectiveness.
TIP_VENOM_1_DESCRIPTION: Fast and inexpensive, the Venom is an excellent choice for hunting down enemy infantry squads.
TIP_VIPER_1_DESCRIPTION: The Phantom is equipped with EMP missiles. Use them to slow down fast moving enemy aircraft.
TIP_WARDOGS_1_DESCRIPTION: War Dogs are a great low cost scouting unit when opening with a War Factory.
TIP_WIDOWMAKER_1_DESCRIPTION: Widowmakers are great at dealing with both enemy infantry and aircraft.
TIP_WIN_STREAKS_DISABLED: Win Streaks are disabled in Master League and beyond.
TIP_WOLVERINE_1_DESCRIPTION: Wolverines are a great answer to swarms of enemy infantry squads.
TIP_WRAITH_1_DESCRIPTION: The Shade will deploy an EMP Blast upon breaking Stealth. Take care in positioning the unit.
TIP_ZONETROOPER_1_DESCRIPTION: Zone Troopers heal when out of combat. Pull them out of harms way when their health starts to get low.
UI_ABILITY_COORDINATED_ASSAULT_DESC: Increases a unit's Attack Speed and Movement Speed by <stat|BuffEffect> for a short duration.
UI_ABILITY_DRILL_POD_DESC: Deploys a squad of Flame Troopers anywhere on the battlefield.
UI_ABILITY_FANATICISM_DESC: Increases a unit's Attack Speed and Movement Speed by <stat|BuffEffect>% for a short duration, but causes them to take <stat|DebuffEffect>% more damage.
UI_ABILITY_ION_CANNON_DESC: Targets any tile on the battlefield. After <stat|RampTime> seconds, it deals massive damage to any unit there and medium damage to ALL adjacent units.
UI_ABILITY_TIBERIUM_STRIKE_DESCRIPTION: Fires a medium-damage missile. If it hits Tiberium Gas, its damage is increased and it also damages ALL adjacent tiles.

UI_COMMANDER_GDI_JACKSON_FLAVOR: Col. Jackson grew up on a military base, where his father was in the old American army. Jackson has no use for fancy technology; he leverages sound tactics and battlefield grit to win the day.
UI_COMMANDER_GDI_LIANG_FLAVOR: Dr. Liang worked side-by-side with his sister, Jade, in the GDI research labs until they were both accidentally exposed to raw Tiberium. Liang chose to amputate his arm rather than succumb to mutation. He now dedicates himself to finding ways to heal wounds of all kinds.
UI_COMMANDER_GDI_MCNEIL_FLAVOR: Using the technology developed from Sonic Crystals, McNeil oversaw a division of the GDI that took Harmonic Resonance technology in a new direction. By diffusing some of the focused sonic waves that made up Disruptor technology, the GDI science division was able to create the Resonance Field to help secure forward bases against Nod forces on the warfront.
UI_COMMANDER_GDI_SOLOMON_FLAVOR: Stationed aboard the GDSS Philadelphia, Gen. James Solomon is the Supreme Commander of the Global Defense Initiative. Solomon’s bitter hatred of Kane often manifests itself in his eagerness to use the powerful Ion Cannon against Brotherhood forces.
UI_COMMANDER_GDI_STRONGARM_FLAVOR: Lt. Strongarm leads the finest corps of engineers in the GDI armed forces. Tough as nails and smart as a whip, she delights in pulling pranks on the other members of the rank and file.
UI_COMMANDER_NOD_JADE_FLAVOR: Jade was once a GDI researcher along with her brother, Dr. Liang, before an accident exposed her body to raw Tiberium. Fascinated by her subsequent mutation, Jade defected to the Brotherhood. There she continues her radical research into Tiberium and its destructive properties.
UI_COMMANDER_NOD_KANE_FLAVOR: Kane is the enigmatic leader of the Brotherhood of Nod. His powerful, ruthless presence has inspired a generation of men and women to join his crusade. Although he heads a worldwide cult and paramilitary organization, little is known of Kane’s origins.
UI_COMMANDER_NOD_OXANNA_FLAVOR: Oxanna Kristos is Nod’s Chief Propagandist; she is exceptionally skilled at manipulating the media to achieve Kane’s goals. Oxanna’s impassioned speeches inspire an unrivaled furor and zeal in all members of the Brotherhood.
UI_COMMANDER_NOD_SETH_FLAVOR: Seth’s ambition and ruthlessness have earned him a place as Kane’s second-in-command. He can be a powerful ally, but fellow Nod commanders would be wise to never trust him fully.

UI_GDI_APC_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The humble GDI A.P.C. Mk III is not the most flashy unit in the GDI arsenal, but its advanced crew safety systems make it a favorite of GDI infantry units across the globe. GDI Missile Squads transported by the A.P.C. routinely survive the destruction of the vehicle and continue fighting in its place.
UI_GDI_APC_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Leaves behind a Missile Squad upon death.
UI_GDI_BATTERINGRAM_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Battering Ram is a quadrupedal demolition mech adapted by GDI for battlefield use. It’s four legged design allows it to clamber over and on to rock formations, allowing it to take out hard to reach enemy structures.
UI_GDI_BATTERINGRAM_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can climb over and stand on rocks. Can ONLY attack structures.
UI_GDI_DISRUPTOR_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Disruptor is an experimental siege weapon which uses sonic energy to batter down enemy structures and devastate enemy infantry. Although largely phased out by the Third Tiberium War, the Disruptor remains a potent anti-structure unit.
UI_GDI_DISRUPTOR_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away. Damages any enemy in the beam.
UI_GDI_DRONESWARM_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: GDI's Drone Swarm is an outgrowth of Dr. Liang's research into pilotless aircraft. The Drone Swarm is armed with a light machine gun for front line combat duty. Dr. Liang objected to the weaponizing his drone technology but was ultimately countermanded by General Solomon.
UI_GDI_DRONESWARM_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Flying. (Can move over terrain and enemy units.)
UI_GDI_GRENADIER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Grenadier has been a common sight in GDI armies since the very first Tiberium War. The modern Grenadier Squad is equipped with stielhandgranate-style grenades for increased range and an EMP charged payload which can slow down even the largest enemy ground vehicles.
UI_GDI_GRENADIER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks against vehicles slow their Attack Speed by <stat|AttackDebuffEffect>% and Movement Speed by <stat|MovementDebuffEffect>% for <stat|DebuffDuration> seconds.
UI_GDI_HAMMERHEAD_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The AH-68 Hammerhead is a dedicated air superiority fighter. Designed to clear the sky of enemy aircraft, the Hammerhead has powerful air-to-air missile systems and heavy composite armors that allow it to take on even the most dangerous airborne threats.
UI_GDI_HAMMERHEAD_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can also attack the enemy base. Flying.
UI_GDI_JUGGERNAUT_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: GDI’s fearsome Juggernaut is a heavy artillery walker sporting naval artillery and a modified Titan chassis. The Juggernaut’s triple cannons allow it to blanket a large area with artillery fire from far behind the front lines. This awesome firepower is somewhat offset by the Juggernaut’s relatively light armor and long pre-fire setup time.
UI_GDI_JUGGERNAUT_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away. Hits multiple tiles with each volley.
UI_GDI_JUMPTROOPERS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Jump Jet Troopers are a squad of elite anti-vehicle infantry equipped with a mobility-enhancing J-70 Jetpack. Although their jetpack is not powerful enough for sustained flight, it does allow Jump Jet Troopers to vault over terrain obstacles and move quickly across the battlefield.
UI_GDI_JUMPTROOPERS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can move over terrain and enemy units. Reveals adjacent stealthed units.
UI_GDI_KODIAK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Kodiak class command ships, made famous by Cmd. Michael McNeil during the second Tiberium War, are heavy gunships capable of shelling multiple ground targets simultaneously. Slow but heavily armored, Kodiaks are valued for their ability to quickly destroy large formations of enemy ground units.
UI_GDI_KODIAK_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can simultaneously attack up to 3 enemies in an arc. Flying.
UI_GDI_MAMMOTH_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Mammoth Mk. III is the third generation of the GDI’s imposing Mammoth Tank line. The heaviest of GDI’s tanks, the Mammoth is equipped with dual 150mm smooth-bore cannons as well as dual anti-aircraft rocket pods.
UI_GDI_MAMMOTH_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack while moving. Crushes infantry, killing them by moving over them.
UI_GDI_MGSQUAD_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Machine Gun Squad is a man-portable heavy machine gun operated by a crew of 3. MG Squads, although extremely slow and unable to attack on the move, have great firepower and extreme durability when deployed, making them ideal for harvester defense and occupying strategic locations.
UI_GDI_MGSQUAD_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away, but must set up first. Takes <stat|BuffEffect>% reduced damage when setup.
UI_GDI_MLRS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: One of the oldest designs in the GDI arsenal, the M270 Multiple Launch Rocket System is a long-range artillery system that delivers a barrage of unguided rockets to the enemy position. The MLRS requires some deployment time before firing; careful positioning is recommended.
UI_GDI_MLRS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away, but must set up first.  Rapidly fires <stat|Clip> rockets, then must reload.
UI_GDI_MOHAWKGUNSHIP_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: GDI's AH-95 Mohawk Gunship was developed to give GDI a heavily armed ground attack craft that could loiter over enemy targets but was neither as fragile as the Orca Assault Craft nor as expensive as a Kodiak Command Ship.
UI_GDI_MOHAWKGUNSHIP_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Flying. Must turn so that its target is to its left before firing.
UI_GDI_MSV_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Mobile Support Vehicle (M.S.V. for short) brings GDI vehicle support to the front lines. Much like it’s construction cousin, the M.C.V., the Mobile Support Vehicle can quickly deploy into a structure on the front lines. Any vehicles that visit the M.S.V leave with juiced up engines and and more powerful guns.
UI_GDI_MSV_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Buffs allied vehicles' Attack Speed by <stat|BuffEffect2>% and increases Movement Speed slightly for <stat|BuffDuration> seconds.
UI_GDI_ORCABOMBER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Orca Bomber, designed by GDI's Engineering Corps, is a bomber aircraft first deployed during the Second Tiberium War. The bomber's heavy bomb load allows it to devastate large formations of enemy ground units, however it's slow speed and large radar signature make it easy prey for enemy fighter aircraft and ground-based anti-air units.
UI_GDI_ORCABOMBER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Flying. Rapidly damages ALL adjacent ground units, then must reload. Fires while moving.
UI_GDI_ORCA_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Orca assault craft, with its distinctive dual ducted-jet propulsion systems, is GDI’s primary close-air support gunship. Specialized for anti-vehicle operations, the Orca is equipped with dual Dragon TOW Rockets that can mete out heavy damage to Nod ground forces.
UI_GDI_ORCA_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Rapidly fires 4 rockets, then must reload. Flying.
UI_GDI_PITBULL_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The CC-6 Pitbull is a light and fast reconnaissance vehicle used primarily for harassing enemy formations and defending against enemy aircraft. One of the least armored of GDI’s ground units, the Pitbull requires quick maneuvering to stay out of trouble.
UI_GDI_PREDATOR_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The MBT-6 Predator is GDI’s main battle tank. First fielded during the Third Tiberium War, the 65-ton Predator Tank forms the backbone of GDI armored forces. GDI armored warfare doctrine recommends leveraging the Predator’s advanced targeting systems to engage targets while on the move and avoiding enemy aircraft whenever possible.
UI_GDI_RANGERS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Sniper Team is an elite infantry unit useful for eliminating enemy infantry at long range. In addition to their high-caliber GLS-70 sniper rifle, the Sniper Team sports a distinctive Ghillie Cloak, the sight of which strikes fear into Nod infantry the world over.
UI_GDI_RANGERS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away. Reveals adjacent stealthed units.
UI_GDI_RAZORBACK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Designed from the guns out to be the ultimate anti-infantry aircraft, the Razorback provides GDI forces with precision strafing runs on soft targets with its twin 8mm rotating cannons. The Razorback can take advantage of its extremely agile design to maneuver around the battlefield and chase down escaping infantry units with ease.
UI_GDI_REPAIRDRONE_DESCRIPTION: Heals adjacent allies for a percent of their maximum health every second. Loses health over time.
UI_GDI_RHINO_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Rhino is GDI’s primary all-terrain scout vehicle. Fast, lightly armored and armed with a M60 machine gun, the Rhino is useful in both anti-infantry and anti-aircraft operations.
UI_GDI_RHINO_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack both Air and Ground units.
UI_GDI_RIFLEMEN_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The riflemen squad is GDI’s standard infantry formation. Equipped with GD-2 automatic rifles and composite body armor, GDI Riflemen are an inexpensive and effective way of destroying enemy infantry units.
UI_GDI_RIFLEMEN_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Provides vision up to <stat|VisionRange> tiles away and reveals adjacent stealthed units.
UI_GDI_ROBODOGS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: GDI War Dogs are an evolution of a quadrupedal chassis that was built for a 1/200th scale prototype of the Mammoth Mk. II walker. Although that chassis design was unworkable at Mammoth scale, GDI scientists found it to be an excellent platform on which to build a light autonomous scout vehicle.
UI_GDI_ROBODOGS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Has four vehicles per squad instead of the usual one.
UI_GDI_ROCKETMAN_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Missile Squad is GDI’s primary anti-vehicle infantry unit. Equipped with FGM-90 shoulder-mounted missile launchers, they are effective against both vehicles and aircraft alike.
UI_GDI_SANDSTORM_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The AHV-8 Sandstorm is a GDI hover vehicle first fielded after the 3rd Tiberium War. The Sandstorm is noteable for its ability to fire a seemingly endless volley of guided missiles at multiple enemy air and ground forces simultaneously.
UI_GDI_SANDSTORM_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Deals damage to up to 3 enemies in an arc.
UI_GDI_SHATTERER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The GDI Shatterer is an infantry suppression weapon that combines GDI hover tech and sonic tech. The Shatterer's concentrated sonic-seismic hybrid wave damages and stuns enemy infantry units.
UI_GDI_SHATTERER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Stuns enemy Infantry with each attack.
UI_GDI_SHOCKTROOPERS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Shockwave Troopers are elite GDI ground troops armed with miniturized Disruptor technology. Although less powerful than the Disruptor, the Shockwave Troopers lower cost and ability to be deployed from the Barracks had made them a staple among GDI infantry forces.
UI_GDI_SLINGSHOT_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Slingshot is a mobile anti-air weapons platform utilizing GDI hover technology. Advanced radar systems allow the Slingshot to track and engage airborne targets at extreme ranges, enabling effective and cost efficent air cover for GDI ground forces.
UI_GDI_SLINGSHOT_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Has an extremely high Attack Speed and 2 Attack Range.
UI_GDI_SPAWN_REPAIRDRONE_DESC: Constructs a repair drone on the targeted tiles.
UI_GDI_SPAWN_TURRET_DESC: Constructs a turret on the battlefield that is strong against infantry and aircraft. Loses health over time.
UI_GDI_TALON_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: A multi-role attack helicopter, the GDI Talon is the last pre-Orca aircraft left in GDI’s arsenal. Despite its older design, the Talon is still a capable weapons platform useful for a variety of roles, including infantry suppression and light anti-aircraft duty.
UI_GDI_TITAN_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Titan MK. II-P is a main battle walker equipped with an experimental particle beam cannon. First fielded during the Second Tiberium War, the Titan family of assault mechs have been a mainstay of GDI armies for decades.
UI_GDI_TITAN_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Fires through its target, also damaging any enemy in the tile behind its target.
UI_GDI_WOLVERINE_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Wolverine Assault Mech is a light battle walker equipped with dual M99 SuperVulcan Gatling machine guns. The Wolverine excels at destroying both infantry formations and enemy aircraft.
UI_GDI_WOLVERINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Has an extremely high Attack Speed.
UI_GDI_ZONETROOPER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Zone Troopers are elite GDI infantry clad in XO-95 power armor. This armor enables Zone Troopers to accurately wield heavy rail guns and will automatically deliver first aid to them over time.
UI_GDI_ZONETROOPER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Restores health every second after being out of combat.

UI_NOD_ARTILLERY_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Nod Artillery is a self-propelled artillery vehicle that fires high-explosive shells at extreme range. Relatively low-tech by Nod standards, the Nod Artillery is still extremely effective at shelling all manner of ground targets.
UI_NOD_ARTILLERY_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack up to 3 tiles away in a cone, but it must set up first.
UI_NOD_ATTACKBIKE_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Attack Bike is a classic Nod weapon design; it’s extremely fast but lightly armored. Nod offensive doctrine emphasizes using Attack Bikes for hit-and-run raids against enemy vehicles and aircraft, while avoiding direct confrontation with enemy heavy armor whenever possible.
UI_NOD_ATTACKBIKE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Has three vehicles per squad instead of the usual one.
UI_NOD_AVATAR_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Avatar Warmech is designed to counter the heaviest units in GDI's arsenal. Equipped with both an Obelisk-class laser cannon and a powerful flamethrower, the Avatar can dispatch enemy ground units with ease.
UI_NOD_AVATAR_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Explodes on death, damaging all adjacent ground units.
UI_NOD_BANSHEE_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Banshee was Nod’s primary multi-role fighter aircraft during the Second Tiberium War. Based on Scrin technology and utilizing exotic plasma cannons, the Banshee is a capable weapon against both aircraft and ground vehicles.
UI_NOD_BASILISK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Nicknamed “The Flying Obelisk” by GDI pilots, the Basilisk is a massive siege aircraft armed with Obelisk-class laser weapons. The Basilisk's laser ramps up its intensity slowly but can fire a continuous beam at enemy units and structures indefinitely.
UI_NOD_BASILISK_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: After attacking for <stat|RampTime> seconds, damage increases significantly. Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away. Flying.
UI_NOD_BEAMCANNON_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Giga-Cannon is the latest and most terrifying result of Nod’s research into directed energy weapons and AI systems. Developed as the true successor to Nod’s Beam Cannon, the Giga-Cannon’s refractive laser is capable of cutting through large enemy formations with ease.
UI_NOD_BEAMCANNON_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Beam splits to hit multiple targets after <stat|RampTime> seconds. Can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away.
UI_NOD_BUGGY_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Buggy is emblematic of Nod’s early weapon design philosophy. Fast, inexpensive and lightly armored, the Buggy is able to zip around the battlefield performing reconnaissance, anti-infantry and anti-aircraft operations.
UI_NOD_CATALYSTGUNSHIP_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTIO: Following the development of the Catalyst Missile, Jade began working on smaller version capable of mass production. She was able to successfully miniaturize the explosive capabilities of the Missile in the form of an incendiary round capable of being fired from a helicopter without risk of backlash. Combined with a 40mm Chemical Grenade launcher, the Catalyst Gunship can create concentrations of Tiberium gas to ignite with its own Catalyst Rounds.
UI_NOD_CATALYSTGUNSHIP_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Launches a Tiberium gas grenade that leaves behind Tiberium gas on impact every 5 seconds. Deals bonus damage to a unit sitting in Tiberium gas.
UI_NOD_CATALYST_GUNSHIP_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Launches a Tiberium gas grenade that leaves behind Tiberium gas on impact every 6 seconds. Deals bonus damage to a unit in Tiberium gas; consumes gas on impact.
UI_NOD_CENTURION_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Centurion is the result of Kane's demand for "a mechanized Praetorian Guard, worthy of defending God's chosen on earth." The Centurion is piloted by battle-hardened veterans, and equipped with a unique "Testudo" shield system able to absorb heavy weapon attacks, making it ideal for defensive operations.
UI_NOD_CHEMICALWARRIOR_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTIO: Chemical Warriors are advanced soldiers recruited from Nod’s elite Black Hand organization. Specially trained and equipped, they produce Tiberium Gas clouds that are highly toxic and corrosive.
UI_NOD_CHEMICALWARRIOR_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks leave behind Tiberium Gas that damages ANY ground unit. Immune to Tiberium damage.
UI_NOD_CHEMQUAD_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Chem Buggy is Nod's first known attempt to mechanize Dr. Giraud's corrosive Tiberium gas cloud weaponry. The Chem Buggy's ability to fire on the move allows aggressive Nod commanders to quickly spray down large enemy troop formations with ease.
UI_NOD_CHEMQUAD_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks leave behind Tiberium Gas that damages ANY ground unit. Can attack while moving.
UI_NOD_CONFESSOR_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Confessors are an elite caste of Nod spiritual and military leaders. Their black armor, red capes and intimidating presence inspires zeal in their followers and terror in their enemies. Known to wield heavy gatling guns, they can tear enemy infantry and aircraft to shreds.
UI_NOD_CONFESSOR_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Empowers other friendly adjacent infantry units with <stat|BuffEffect>% increased Attack Speed. Reveals adjacent stealthed units.
UI_NOD_CYBERWHEEL_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: C.A.B.A.L. weapon design subroutine 0x64 active. Loading primary design requirements: {Speed} {Flexibility} {Terror}. Evaluating Nod technical databases… 8327 results. Executing combinatorial optimization 0x32A. Top result (99.8924 confidence interval): Conveyance {Gyrostabilized monowheel}, Armament {Automatic Rifle}, Operator {AI Pilot subroutine 0x6}, Designation {Cyberwheel}. Subroutine complete.
UI_NOD_CYBORG_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Cyborg Reaper, upgraded with charged particle beams developed by the Black Hand organization, can inflict EMP damage on enemy vehicles and aircraft. The quadrupedal Cyborg combines several Nod technological breakthroughs into a single terrifying unit, the very sight of which instills fear into all enemies of Kane.
UI_NOD_CYBORG_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks against vehicles and aircraft slow their Attack Speed and Movement Speed by <stat|DebuffEffect>% for <stat|DebuffDuration> seconds.
UI_NOD_DRILL_POD_DESC: Agile ground vehicle good at ambushing enemy infantry.
UI_NOD_FANATIC_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Nod Fanatics are handpicked squads of the most zealous Nod foot-soldiers. They are charged with carrying Nod's colors into battle, dreaming of inspiring their comrades by sacrificing themselves in battle.
UI_NOD_FANATIC_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Empowers allied, adjacent units on death with <stat|BuffEffect>% increased Attack Speed and <stat|BuffEffect2>% increased Movement Speed for <stat|BuffDuration> seconds.
UI_NOD_FIREBOMBER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Inferno is a heavy bomber aircraft based on scaled-up Banshee technology. It's equipped with a single, high-yield incendiary bomb capable of annihilating enemy ground units as well as igniting enemy positions for a significant length of time.
UI_NOD_FIREBOMBER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks two tiles in a line, creating fire that damages ANY ground unit. Moves <stat|ReloadSpeedBoost>% faster while reloading. Flying.
UI_NOD_FLAMETANK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The third-generation Flame Tank is a terror weapon of enormous anti-structure potential. Sporting powerful dual flame cannons, the Flame Tank can lay waste to masses of infantry — friend or foe — in a single attack.
UI_NOD_FLAMETANK_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Damages up to 4 tiles in a cone while attacking.
UI_NOD_FLAMETROOPERS_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Flame Trooper squad is the current iteration of Nod’s terrifying shock troops. Armed with dual flame cannons, Flame Troopers can quickly lay waste to enemy infantry and structures alike; however, they tend to do little damage to enemy vehicles.
UI_NOD_LASERDRONE_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Laser Drones are the result of Kane's directive to utilize recruits from Yellow Zones whose physical limitations, brought on by years of Tiberium exposure, made them unsuitable for standard service. It was found that by forcibly transplanting the cerebrum of these recruits into a Laser Drone they could provide a few days of valuable service to the Brotherhood despite their disabilities.
UI_NOD_LASERTROOPER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Laser Squads are equipped with anti-air/anti-vehicle laser weaponry derived from Nod’s fearsome Obelisk of Light technology.
UI_NOD_MILITANT_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Nod Militants are the Brotherhood's primary light infantry force. Militants are poorly trained and equipped but fight with fanatical zeal.
UI_NOD_MILITANT_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Provides vision up to 3 tiles away and reveals adjacent stealthed units.
UI_NOD_MUTANTMARAUDER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Mutant Marauders are hulking mercenaries that have been ravaged by Tiberium mutation. The largest type of Forgotten mutants, the Marauders' super strength and size allows them to wield powerful improvised laser weapons built from scavenged Obelisk parts.
UI_NOD_OBELISK_DESCRIPTION: Constructs an anti-vehicle structure anywhere on YOUR side of the battlefield, which can attack up to <stat|ExtendedAttackRange> tiles away. Loses health over time.
UI_NOD_ROCKWORM_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Based on technology developed for the infamous Montauk subterranean transport, the Rockworm is a symbol of Nod’s mastery of burrow technology. The Rockworm’s terrifying size and razor-sharp cutting teeth can reduce even the heaviest GDI armor to shreds in seconds.
UI_NOD_ROCKWORM_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Burrows while moving, becoming untargetable. Deals damage to ALL adjacent ground units upon unburrowing.
UI_NOD_SCARAB_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Scarabs are a result of Nod’s experiments with Artificial Intelligence and will launch themselves without hesitation at enemy formations. These impacts tend to destroy both the Scarab and its target. Ambush enemies with pre-placed Scarabs, as their light armor makes them poorly suited to frontal assaults.
UI_NOD_SCARAB_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Dies upon attacking, creating fire that damages ANY ground unit.
UI_NOD_SCAVENGER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: In the Yellow Zones, you learn that survival always comes first. Scavengers have been raised to find the value in anything they find. The Brotherhood of Nod, who frequently recruit from the Yellow Zone, pay the scavengers for their salvaged goods creating a beneficial relationship between the two parties. The Scavengers are always on the lookout for a bit of coin even if it means benefiting of the deaths of enemies and allies alike.
UI_NOD_SCAVENGER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Gains 10 Tiberium if any unit dies adjacent to the Scavenger.
UI_NOD_SCORPIONTANK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Allegedly designed by Brother Marcion, the Scorpion Tank is Nod’s de facto main battle tank. Emphasizing speed and fire rate over armor, the Scorpion is a poor matchup against heavier GDI vehicles, but it can hold its own against the ubiquitous GDI Predator Tank.
UI_NOD_SPAWN_OBELISK_DESC: Summons an Obelisk of Light on the targeted tile.
UI_NOD_STEALTHTANK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Stealth Tank R3 is the latest variant of Nod’s revolutionary series of invisible tanks. Primarily used in a hit-and-run role, the Stealth Tank is lightly armored but can rapidly launch a series of powerful missile strikes against air and ground targets.
UI_NOD_STEALTHTANK_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Rapidly fires <stat|Clip> missiles, then must reload. Becomes untargetable after being out of combat for <stat|StealthTime> seconds.
UI_NOD_TICKTANK_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Tick Tank is a Nod Battle Tank specialized for defensive operations. The Tick Tank's unique Baryshnikov Dual-Drive tread system allows for both high speed transit and the ability to entrench in the ground, heavily reducing the amount of damage taken from incoming enemy fire.
UI_NOD_TICKTANK_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Entrenches itself when idle, reducing its damage taken by <stat|BuffEffect>%. Can attack while moving.
UI_NOD_VENOM_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Venom Patrol Craft is Nod’s primary aerial scout vehicle. Armed with a heavy ball-mounted machine gun, it’s ideal for hunting down enemy infantry squads. The Venom design is widely believed to have been developed using stolen Orca prototypes.
UI_NOD_VIPER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: Nod’s Phantom air superiority fighter was developed as a response to GDI’s increasing aerial dominance. The Phantom’s missiles employ charged particle EMP generators. This allows the Nod fighter to slow down enemy aircraft, making their escape nearly impossible.
UI_NOD_VIPER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Attacks against aircraft slow their Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Can also attack the enemy base. Flying.
UI_NOD_WIDOWMAKER_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Widowmaker is designed to defend high cost Temple units from infantry and airborne threats. It's fearsome looks are backed up by a dual flame-thrower and an abdomen mounted missile battery. The Widowmaker went through many iterations but the final arachnidian design was selected by Gideon Raveshaw himself for it's "sense of style and class."
UI_NOD_WIDOWMAKER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Can attack both air and ground units.
UI_NOD_WRAITH_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Shade is the next step in Aircraft design for the Brotherhood of Nod. It utilizes the stealth technology of the Stealth Tank and the EMP capabilities of the Phantom to the extreme. Borne from the Black Hand faction of the Brotherhood, the existence of the Shade was a secret known only to a few.
UI_NOD_WRAITH_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: Unleashes an EMP that affects adjacent, enemy Vehicles and Aircraft upon breaking Stealth for 1.5 seconds. Flying.
UI_NOD_WRAIT_FLAVOR_DESCRIPTION: The Shade is the next step in Aircraft for the Nod faction. It utilizes the stealth technology of the Stealth Tank and the EMP capabilities of the Phantom to the extreme. Borne from the Black Hand faction of the Brotherhood of Nod, the existence of the Shade was a secret known only to a few allies and even less enemies.

• Races can consist of GDI, NOD, or GDI and NOD.
• If GDI and NOD races run in parallel, each factions’ medal count is independent from one another.
• The Rivals Race icon will indicate which factions have an active race.
UI_RIVALSRACE_INFOMODAL_LEADERBOARD_BODY:
• The Race leaderboard can be found on the league progression map.
• All race information can be found here: placement, rewards, time remaining, etc.
• Tapping the reward cards on the leaderboard shows a preview of that reward in game.
UI_RIVALSRACE_INFOMODAL_RACE_BODY:
• You are paired with Rivals of a similar medal count and placed into a local leaderboard.
• Compete to see who ends the race with the highest medal count.
• Race medals are a direct result of your medal count within the ladder.
• Top ranked ladder players will be put into a special local leaderboard.
• This special leaderboard will grant rewards more generously than the standard one.
UI_RIVALSRACE_INFOMODAL_REWARDS_BODY:
• Rewards are determined by your placement on your local leaderboard when the race concludes.
• The potential rewards for the current race can be found on the race leaderboard when active.
• Upon dismissing the ‘Race Has Ended’ pop up, you will immediately receive your rewards, if eligible.
• Earning a race reward you already own won’t provide any additional benefit.
UI_SEASONS_INFO_RESET_BODY: When a season ends, all players are reset back to the beginning of Bronze League, and then immediately gain +150 bonus Medals for each Division they reached in the previous season.
UI_SEASONS_INFO_REWARDS_BODY: When a new season begins the ranked Divisions refresh with new rewards that can be earned again. The very first time a player reaches a Division they earn a large amount of bonus rewards. Reaching the same division again in subsequent seasons awards the standard reward.

UI_VAULT_INFO_BODY_1:
The Vault is a unique crate that is only available for a limited time. Opening other crates fills The Vault with cards. All crates you open will fill The Vault with cards, but higher value crates will grant more cards.

Once unlocked, The Vault can be opened at any time for 600 Diamonds. When opened you will receive all the cards in The Vault, at which point The Vault will reset and can be filled again.
UI_VAULT_INFO_BODY_2:
When The Vault reaches its maximum capacity, all further cards earned will be forfeit.
All cards left in The Vault when it expires will be there the next time The Vault is made available.
